name: RapidTriage core forensics #1-#5 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #1 Native EVTX BinXML fixture assertions

required_assertions: EVTX record metadata, promoted fields, duplicate EventData ordering, trusted-tool record diff gating, and BinXML warning coverage are preserved

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; real EvtxECmd/Hayabusa/Windows Event Viewer output, provider-specific grammar, and external corpus validation remain commercial-grade blockers.

datasets.name: #2 EVTX message rendering fixture assertions

required_assertions: message text, inserted parameters, provenance, trusted rendered-message diff gating, unresolved template warnings, and fallback limitations are preserved

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; real Windows Event Viewer/EvtxECmd rendered-message output and provider resource DLL rendering remain commercial-grade evidence.

datasets.name: #3 EVTX recovery fixture assertions

required_assertions: corrupt/slack candidate reason, offset context, integrity status, caution labels, and non-reportable default are preserved

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; large deleted/corrupt EVTX corpus and independent validation remain required.

datasets.name: #4 Registry key tree fixture assertions

required_assertions: registry key tree root reachability, parent-child backlinks, value-list ownership, last-write evidence, and transaction-log disclosure are preserved

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; transaction-log replay and broad hive corpus remain commercial-grade blockers.

datasets.name: #5 Registry deleted key/value fixture assertions

required_assertions: deleted/free key and value candidates preserve allocator evidence, parent confirmation, data plausibility, transaction-log context, and explicit do-not-report-as-fact reportability blocking

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; independent deleted-cell validation and transaction-log replay remain required.
